attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Wyoming annual report. Note: Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - no tax return required. Only annual report filing ($60 domestic, $120 foreign).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has presence in Wyoming (incorporated or registered)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "WY" streq and

action_details.action_comment: Wyoming domestic corporation - annual report required ($60); Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - only annual report ($60)
action_details.action_postfix: result.wy_annual_report_fee_domestic get /result.wy_annual_report_fee xdef 0.0 /result.wy_state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. Domestic corp annual report: $60. Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Wyoming foreign corporation - annual report required ($120); Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - only annual report ($120 foreign)
action_details.action_postfix: result.wy_annual_report_fee_foreign get /result.wy_annual_report_fee xdef 0.0 /result.wy_state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. Foreign corp annual report: $120. Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wyoming presence - no filing requirement; No Wyoming presence - no filing requirement
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wy_annual_report_fee xdef 0.0 /result.wy_state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wyoming presence - no filing required. WY has no corporate income tax anyway. Any payments refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "WY" streq and

action_details.action_comment: Wyoming - no income tax adjustments; Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - no adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef true /result.wy_no_corporate_tax xdef true /result.wy_no_gross_receipts_tax xdef true /result.wy_no_franchise_tax xdef "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax, franchise tax, or gross receipts tax. No adjustments needed." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wyoming presence - no adjustments; No Wyoming presence - no adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef true /result.wy_no_corporate_tax xdef true /result.wy_no_gross_receipts_tax xdef true /result.wy_no_franchise_tax xdef "No Wyoming presence - no tax liability (WY has no corporate income tax anyway)." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Wyoming state tax liability. Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - always returns $0 tax.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has presence in Wyoming (incorporated or registered)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "WY" streq and

action_details.action_comment: Wyoming - $0 corporate tax; Wyoming has NO corporate income tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wy_state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Wyoming State Tax: $0. NO corporate income tax, NO franchise tax, NO gross receipts tax. Any estimated payments refunded. Reference: Wyoming Statutes Title 39" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wyoming presence - $0 tax; No Wyoming presence - $0 tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.wy_state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wyoming presence - $0 tax. Wyoming has no corporate income tax anyway. Any payments refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
